# hay que ajustar el scaling 


```{r}
plot_rda_scaled <- function(df, title_label) {
  env_data <- df[, 3:12]
  com_data <- df[, 13:ncol(df)]

  # Filtrar filas completas
  rows_complete <- complete.cases(env_data)
  env_data_clean <- env_data[rows_complete, ]
  com_data_clean <- com_data[rows_complete, ]
  df_clean <- df[rows_complete, ]

  # RDA
  rda_model <- rda(com_data_clean ~ ., data = env_data_clean)

  # Scores
  sites_df <- scores(rda_model, display = "sites", scaling = 2)
  sites_df <- as.data.frame(sites_df)
  sites_df$ID <- df_clean$ID
  sites_df$group <- df_clean$typeset
  colnames(sites_df)[1:2] <- c("RDA1", "RDA2")

  # Variables ambientales
  env_vectors <- scores(rda_model, display = "bp", scaling = 2)
  env_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = rownames(env_vectors),
    RDA1 = env_vectors[, 1],
    RDA2 = env_vectors[, 2]
  )

  # Normalizar las coordenadas ambientales (0 a 1)
  env_df$RDA1 <- scales::rescale(env_df$RDA1, to = c(0, 1))
  env_df$RDA2 <- scales::rescale(env_df$RDA2, to = c(0, 1))

  # Normalizar coordenadas de sitios también si quieres compararlo (opcional)
  sites_df$RDA1 <- scales::rescale(sites_df$RDA1, to = c(0, 1))
  sites_df$RDA2 <- scales::rescale(sites_df$RDA2, to = c(0, 1))

  # Convex hulls
  convex_hull_df <- sites_df %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    slice(chull(RDA1, RDA2))

  # Gráfico
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = 2, color = "grey70") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = 2, color = "grey70") +
    geom_polygon(data = convex_hull_df, 
                 aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, group = group, fill = group), 
                 alpha = 0.2, color = "gray60") +
    geom_point(data = sites_df, 
               aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, color = group, shape = group), size = 4) +
    geom_text_repel(data = sites_df, 
                    aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, label = ID), size = 2.5) +
    geom_segment(data = env_df, 
                 aes(x = 0.5, y = 0.5, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2), 
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), color = "darkblue") +
    geom_text_repel(data = env_df, 
                    aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, label = Variable), 
                    size = 4, color = "darkblue") +
    labs(title = title_label, x = "Scaled RDA1", y = "Scaled RDA2") +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Phase") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1", name = "Phase") +
    theme_minimal() +
    coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1))

  return(list(plot = p, model = rda_model))
}
```

```{r}
plot_rda_scaled <- function(df, title_label) {
  library(vegan)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(scales)

  # Separar variables ambientales y lípidos
  env_data <- df[, 3:12]
  com_data <- df[, 13:ncol(df)]

  # Filtrar filas completas
  rows_complete <- complete.cases(env_data)
  env_data_clean <- env_data[rows_complete, ]
  com_data_clean <- com_data[rows_complete, ]
  df_clean <- df[rows_complete, ]

  # RDA
  rda_model <- rda(com_data_clean ~ ., data = env_data_clean)

  # Coordenadas de sitios
  sites_df <- scores(rda_model, display = "sites", scaling = 2)
  sites_df <- as.data.frame(sites_df)
  sites_df$ID <- df_clean$ID
  sites_df$group <- df_clean$typeset

  # 🧹 Simplificar etiquetas
  sites_df$Label <- gsub(".*Mesocosm ([0-9]+_Day_[0-9]+)", "M\\1", sites_df$ID)

  colnames(sites_df)[1:2] <- c("RDA1", "RDA2")

  # Coordenadas de variables ambientales
  env_vectors <- scores(rda_model, display = "bp", scaling = 2)
  env_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = rownames(env_vectors),
    RDA1 = env_vectors[, 1],
    RDA2 = env_vectors[, 2]
  )

  # 🔄 Normalizar ambos a rango 0–1
  sites_df$RDA1 <- rescale(sites_df$RDA1, to = c(0, 1))
  sites_df$RDA2 <- rescale(sites_df$RDA2, to = c(0, 1))
  env_df$RDA1 <- rescale(env_df$RDA1, to = c(0, 1))
  env_df$RDA2 <- rescale(env_df$RDA2, to = c(0, 1))

  # Polygonas por grupo
  convex_hull_df <- sites_df %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    slice(chull(RDA1, RDA2))

  # 🎨 Plot
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = 2, color = "grey70") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = 2, color = "grey70") +
    geom_polygon(data = convex_hull_df, 
                 aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, group = group, fill = group), 
                 alpha = 0.2, color = "gray60") +
    geom_point(data = sites_df, 
               aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, color = group, shape = group), size = 4) +
    geom_text_repel(data = sites_df, 
                    aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, label = Label), 
                    size = 2.5,
                    max.overlaps = Inf) +
    geom_segment(data = env_df, 
                 aes(x = 0.5, y = 0.5, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2), 
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), color = "darkblue") +
    geom_text_repel(data = env_df, 
                    aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, label = Variable), 
                    size = 4, color = "darkblue") +
    labs(title = title_label, x = "Scaled RDA1", y = "Scaled RDA2") +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Phase") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1", name = "Phase") +
    theme_minimal() +
    coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1))

  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
plot_rda_scaled <- function(df, title_label) {
  library(vegan)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(scales)

  # Separar variables ambientales y lípidos
  env_data <- df[, 3:12]
  com_data <- df[, 13:ncol(df)]

  # Filtrar filas completas
  rows_complete <- complete.cases(env_data)
  env_data_clean <- env_data[rows_complete, ]
  com_data_clean <- com_data[rows_complete, ]
  df_clean <- df[rows_complete, ]

  # RDA
  rda_model <- rda(com_data_clean ~ ., data = env_data_clean)

  # Coordenadas de sitios
  sites_df <- scores(rda_model, display = "sites", scaling = 2)
  sites_df <- as.data.frame(sites_df)
  sites_df$ID <- df_clean$ID
  sites_df$group <- df_clean$typeset

  # Simplificar etiquetas para que quepan mejor
  sites_df$Label <- gsub(".*Mesocosm ([0-9]+_Day_[0-9]+)", "M\\1", sites_df$ID)

  # Asegurar orden de fases
  sites_df$group <- factor(sites_df$group, levels = c("Phase1", "Phase2", "Phase3", "Phase4"))

  colnames(sites_df)[1:2] <- c("RDA1", "RDA2")

  # Variables ambientales
  env_vectors <- scores(rda_model, display = "bp", scaling = 2)
  env_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = rownames(env_vectors),
    RDA1 = env_vectors[, 1],
    RDA2 = env_vectors[, 2]
  )

  # Normalizar a 0–1 para visualización
  sites_df$RDA1 <- rescale(sites_df$RDA1, to = c(0, 1))
  sites_df$RDA2 <- rescale(sites_df$RDA2, to = c(0, 1))
  env_df$RDA1 <- rescale(env_df$RDA1, to = c(0, 1))
  env_df$RDA2 <- rescale(env_df$RDA2, to = c(0, 1))

  # Convex hulls
  convex_hull_df <- sites_df %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    slice(chull(RDA1, RDA2))

  # Plot
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = 2, color = "grey70") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = 2, color = "grey70") +
    geom_polygon(data = convex_hull_df, 
             aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, group = group, fill = group, color = group), 
             alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_point(data = sites_df, 
               aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, color = group, shape = group), size = 4, stroke = 1) +
    geom_text_repel(data = sites_df, 
                    aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, label = Label), 
                    size = 2.5,
                    max.overlaps = Inf) +
    geom_segment(data = env_df, 
                 aes(x = 0.5, y = 0.5, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2), 
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), color = "steelblue") +
    geom_text_repel(data = env_df, 
                    aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, label = Variable), 
                    size = 4, color = "steelblue") +
    labs(title = title_label, x = "Scaled RDA1", y = "Scaled RDA2") +
    
    # 🎨 Colores y formas personalizadas por fase
    scale_color_manual(name = "Phase",
                       values = c(
                         "Phase1" = "#99002F",  # burdeos
                         "Phase2" = "#FDBF6F",  # durazno
                         "Phase3" = "#A6CEE3",  # celeste
                         "Phase4" = "#1F78B4"   # azul
                       )) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Phase",
                      values = c(
                        "Phase1" = "#99002F",
                        "Phase2" = "#FDBF6F",
                        "Phase3" = "#A6CEE3",
                        "Phase4" = "#1F78B4"
                      )) +
    scale_shape_manual(name = "Phase",
                       values = c(
                         "Phase1" = 21,
                         "Phase2" = 22,
                         "Phase3" = 23,
                         "Phase4" = 24
                       )) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
theme(
  panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
) +
coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1))

   return(list(plot = p, model = rda_model))
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
#  VARIANCE PARTITIONING - CÓDIGO COMPLETO
#  Lipidoma ~ Ambiente + Comunidad bacteriana
#  Superficie y Subsuperficie
# ============================================================

library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggforce)   # para geom_circle
library(ggrepel)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PASO 1: Asignar IDs reales a matrices de comunidad bacteriana
# (sus rownames originales eran solo números 1,2,3...)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
rownames(ordenes_surface_rel) <- datos_surface_filtrados$ID
rownames(ordenes_bottom_rel)  <- datos_bottom_filtrados$ID

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PASO 2: Extraer las tres matrices por profundidad
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# SUPERFICIE
env_surf_m <- datos_surface_filtrados[, 3:12]
lip_surf_m <- datos_surface_filtrados[, 13:ncol(datos_surface_filtrados)]
bac_surf_m <- ordenes_surface_rel

# SUBSUPERFICIE
env_bot_m  <- datos_bottom_filtrados[, 3:12]
lip_bot_m  <- datos_bottom_filtrados[, 13:ncol(datos_bottom_filtrados)]
bac_bot_m  <- ordenes_bottom_rel

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PASO 3: Eliminar columnas no numéricas de bacterias
# (ID, Mesocosm, Phase, Grupo que estaban al final)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
bac_surf_m <- bac_surf_m[, sapply(bac_surf_m, is.numeric)]
bac_bot_m  <- bac_bot_m[,  sapply(bac_bot_m,  is.numeric)]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PASO 4: Filas completas
# ------------------------------------------------------------
rows_surf <- complete.cases(env_surf_m)
rows_bot  <- complete.cases(env_bot_m)

env_surf_m <- env_surf_m[rows_surf, ]
lip_surf_m <- lip_surf_m[rows_surf, ]
bac_surf_m <- bac_surf_m[rows_surf, ]

env_bot_m  <- env_bot_m[rows_bot, ]
lip_bot_m  <- lip_bot_m[rows_bot, ]
bac_bot_m  <- bac_bot_m[rows_bot, ]

cat("SUPERFICIE  env/lip/bac:", nrow(env_surf_m), nrow(lip_surf_m), nrow(bac_surf_m), "\n")
cat("SUBSUPERFICIE env/lip/bac:", nrow(env_bot_m), nrow(lip_bot_m), nrow(bac_bot_m), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PASO 5: Transformación Hellinger
# ------------------------------------------------------------
lip_surf_hell <- decostand(lip_surf_m, method = "hellinger")
bac_surf_hell <- decostand(bac_surf_m, method = "hellinger")
lip_bot_hell  <- decostand(lip_bot_m,  method = "hellinger")
bac_bot_hell  <- decostand(bac_bot_m,  method = "hellinger")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PASO 6: Reducir bacterias a ejes PCoA
# (necesario para evitar overfitting: más variables que muestras)
# Superficie: k=4 ejes, Subsuperficie: k=2 ejes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# SUPERFICIE
pcoa_surf    <- cmdscale(vegdist(bac_surf_m, method = "bray"), k = 4, eig = TRUE)
bac_surf_pcoa <- as.data.frame(pcoa_surf$points)
colnames(bac_surf_pcoa) <- paste0("PCoA", 1:4)

var_surf <- round(pcoa_surf$eig / sum(pcoa_surf$eig[pcoa_surf$eig > 0]) * 100, 1)
cat("Varianza PCoA superficie (4 ejes):", sum(var_surf[1:4]), "%\n")

# SUBSUPERFICIE: k=2 + selección forward de variables ambientales
pcoa_bot     <- cmdscale(vegdist(bac_bot_m, method = "bray"), k = 2, eig = TRUE)
bac_bot_pcoa2 <- as.data.frame(pcoa_bot$points)
colnames(bac_bot_pcoa2) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")

var_bot <- round(pcoa_bot$eig / sum(pcoa_bot$eig[pcoa_bot$eig > 0]) * 100, 1)
cat("Varianza PCoA subsuperficie (2 ejes):", sum(var_bot[1:2]), "%\n")

# Selección forward de variables ambientales para subsuperficie
# (con 15 muestras no podemos usar las 10 variables)
set.seed(123)
rda_full_bot <- rda(lip_bot_hell ~ ., data = env_bot_m)
rda_null_bot <- rda(lip_bot_hell ~ 1, data = env_bot_m)
fwd_bot      <- ordiR2step(rda_null_bot,
                            scope = formula(rda_full_bot),
                            direction = "forward",
                            permutations = 999)

env_bot_sel <- env_bot_m[, attr(fwd_bot$terms, "term.labels")]
cat("Variables ambientales seleccionadas (subsuperficie):", 
    colnames(env_bot_sel), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PASO 7: Variance partitioning
# ------------------------------------------------------------
vp_surf <- varpart(lip_surf_hell, env_surf_m,  bac_surf_pcoa)
vp_bot  <- varpart(lip_bot_hell,  env_bot_sel, bac_bot_pcoa2)

print(vp_surf)
print(vp_bot)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PASO 8: Tests de significancia (fracciones [a] y [c])
# rda(Y, Predictores, Covariable_a_controlar)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n========== SUPERFICIE ==========\n")
cat("[a] Solo ambiente | controlando comunidad:\n")
anova_a_surf <- anova(rda(lip_surf_hell, env_surf_m, bac_surf_pcoa), permutations = 999)
print(anova_a_surf)

cat("[c] Solo comunidad | controlando ambiente:\n")
anova_c_surf <- anova(rda(lip_surf_hell, bac_surf_pcoa, env_surf_m), permutations = 999)
print(anova_c_surf)

cat("\n========== SUBSUPERFICIE ==========\n")
cat("[a] Solo ambiente | controlando comunidad:\n")
anova_a_bot <- anova(rda(lip_bot_hell, env_bot_sel, bac_bot_pcoa2), permutations = 999)
print(anova_a_bot)

cat("[c] Solo comunidad | controlando ambiente:\n")
anova_c_bot <- anova(rda(lip_bot_hell, bac_bot_pcoa2, env_bot_sel), permutations = 999)
print(anova_c_bot)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PASO 9: Figura con ggplot2
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# --- Datos para el plot ---
# Extraer R2 ajustados de varpart
fracs_surf <- data.frame(
  depth    = "Surface",
  fraction = c("[a]\nAmb. only", "[b]\nShared", "[c]\nComm. only", "[d]\nResidual"),
  value    = c(
    vp_surf$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[1],  # [a]
    vp_surf$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[2],  # [b]
    vp_surf$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[3],  # [c]
    vp_surf$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[4]   # [d]
  ),
  pval = c(
    anova_a_surf$`Pr(>F)`[1],   # [a]
    NA,                          # [b] no testeable
    anova_c_surf$`Pr(>F)`[1],   # [c]
    NA                           # [d]
  )
)

fracs_bot <- data.frame(
  depth    = "Subsurface",
  fraction = c("[a]\nAmb. only", "[b]\nShared", "[c]\nComm. only", "[d]\nResidual"),
  value    = c(
    vp_bot$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[1],
    vp_bot$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[2],
    vp_bot$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[3],
    vp_bot$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[4]
  ),
  pval = c(
    anova_a_bot$`Pr(>F)`[1],
    NA,
    anova_c_bot$`Pr(>F)`[1],
    NA
  )
)

fracs_all <- bind_rows(fracs_surf, fracs_bot) %>%
  mutate(
    depth    = factor(depth, levels = c("Surface", "Subsurface")),
    fraction = factor(fraction, levels = c("[a]\nAmb. only", "[b]\nShared", 
                                           "[c]\nComm. only", "[d]\nResidual")),
    # Etiqueta de significancia
    sig_label = case_when(
      is.na(pval)   ~ "",
      pval <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      pval <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      pval <= 0.05  ~ "*",

    # Colores por fracción

# --- Plot de barras apiladas ---
```

# Interpretación
La figura muestra que el lipidoma es controlado por dos procesos simultáneos:
[c] Comunidad > [a] Ambiente en ambas profundidades significa que el turnover taxonómico (quién está presente) explica más varianza única que el ambiente solo. Esto valida la preocupación del revisor — pero no elimina el remodeling, lo contextualiza.
La fracción [b] compartida es grande en superficie (33.5%), lo que refleja que en este experimento ambiente y comunidad están altamente acoplados — cuando el ambiente cambia, la comunidad también cambia, y es difícil separar ambos efectos completamente. Eso es ecológicamente esperado en un mesocosmo.
El residual alto en subsuperficie (43%) sugiere que hay variables no medidas que controlan el lipidoma en esa capa — posiblemente gradientes de oxígeno más finos, o interacciones entre organismos.
En una frase para el paper: "Both environmental conditions and community turnover independently and significantly explained lipidome variability, with community structure accounting for a larger unique fraction, suggesting that lipidome dynamics reflect a combination of physiological remodeling and taxonomic succession."

#Ahora por Phases


```{r}
# ============================================================
#  VARIANCE PARTITIONING POR FASES
#  Phase I (1-11) | Phase II (12-19) | Phase III (20-37) | Phase IV (38-50)
# ============================================================

library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(eulerr)
library(grid)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# FUNCIÓN PRINCIPAL
# ------------------------------------------------------------
run_varpart_phase <- function(phase_name, lip_data, bac_data) {
  
  cat("\n", rep("=", 50), "\n")
  cat("  FASE:", phase_name, "\n")
  cat(rep("=", 50), "\n")
  
  # --- 1. Filtrar por fase ---
  idx_lip <- lip_data$typeset == phase_name
  idx_bac <- bac_data$typeset == phase_name
  lip_ph  <- lip_data[idx_lip, ]
  bac_ph  <- bac_data[idx_bac, ]
  
  # --- 2. Match por ID ---
  ids_comunes <- intersect(lip_ph$ID, bac_ph$ID)
  if (length(ids_comunes) < 5) {
    cat("⚠ Menos de 5 muestras comunes, saltando\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  cat("Muestras comunes:", length(ids_comunes), "\n")
  
  lip_ph <- lip_ph[match(ids_comunes, lip_ph$ID), ]
  bac_ph <- bac_ph[match(ids_comunes, bac_ph$ID), ]
  
  # --- 3. Matrices ---
  env_m <- lip_ph[, 3:12]
  lip_m <- lip_ph[, 13:ncol(lip_ph)]
  bac_m <- bac_ph[, sapply(bac_ph, is.numeric)]
  
  rows_ok <- complete.cases(env_m)
  env_m   <- env_m[rows_ok, ]
  lip_m   <- lip_m[rows_ok, ]
  bac_m   <- bac_m[rows_ok, ]
  n <- nrow(env_m)
  cat("Muestras tras NAs:", n, "\n")
  if (n < 5) { cat("⚠ Muy pocas muestras\n"); return(NULL) }
  
  # --- 4. Hellinger ---
  lip_hell <- decostand(lip_m, method = "hellinger")
  
  # --- 5. NOVEDAD: Reducir ambiente a ejes PCA ---
  # Con n pequeño usamos máximo 2 ejes PCA ambientales
  k_env <- min(2, n - 2)
  env_scaled <- scale(env_m)
  # Eliminar columnas con varianza 0 o NA
  env_scaled <- env_scaled[, apply(env_scaled, 2, function(x) !any(is.na(x)) && var(x) > 0)]
  pca_env    <- prcomp(env_scaled, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
  env_pca    <- as.data.frame(pca_env$x[, 1:k_env])
  colnames(env_pca) <- paste0("EnvPC", 1:k_env)
  
  var_env <- round(summary(pca_env)$importance[2, 1:k_env] * 100, 1)
  cat("Ejes PCA ambiente usados:", k_env,
      "| Varianza:", paste(var_env, collapse = " + "), "%\n")
  
  # --- 6. Reducir bacterias a ejes PCoA ---
  k_bac <- min(2, n - 2)
  pcoa_res <- cmdscale(vegdist(bac_m, method = "bray"), k = k_bac, eig = TRUE)
  bac_pcoa <- as.data.frame(pcoa_res$points)
  colnames(bac_pcoa) <- paste0("PCoA", 1:k_bac)
  
  var_bac <- round(pcoa_res$eig / sum(pcoa_res$eig[pcoa_res$eig > 0]) * 100, 1)
  cat("Ejes PCoA bacterias usados:", k_bac,
      "| Varianza:", sum(var_bac[1:k_bac]), "%\n")
  
  # --- 7. Variance partitioning ---
  vp <- tryCatch(
    varpart(lip_hell, env_pca, bac_pcoa),
    error = function(e) { cat("⚠ varpart falló:", e$message, "\n"); NULL }
  )
  if (is.null(vp)) return(NULL)
  
  # --- 8. Tests de significancia ---
  anova_a <- tryCatch(
    anova(rda(lip_hell, env_pca, bac_pcoa), permutations = 999),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  anova_c <- tryCatch(
    anova(rda(lip_hell, bac_pcoa, env_pca), permutations = 999),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  # --- 9. Resultados ---
  a_val <- vp$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[1]
  b_val <- vp$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[2]
  c_val <- vp$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[3]
  d_val <- vp$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[4]
  p_a   <- if (!is.null(anova_a)) anova_a$`Pr(>F)`[1] else NA
  p_c   <- if (!is.null(anova_c)) anova_c$`Pr(>F)`[1] else NA
  
  cat(sprintf("[a] Ambiente único:  %.1f%%  (p=%.3f)\n", a_val*100, ifelse(is.na(p_a), NaN, p_a)))
  cat(sprintf("[b] Compartido:      %.1f%%\n",            b_val*100))
  cat(sprintf("[c] Comunidad única: %.1f%%  (p=%.3f)\n", c_val*100, ifelse(is.na(p_c), NaN, p_c)))
  cat(sprintf("[d] Residual:        %.1f%%\n",            d_val*100))
  
  list(phase=phase_name, a=a_val, b=b_val, c=c_val, d=d_val,
       p_a=p_a, p_c=p_c, vp=vp, anova_a=anova_a, anova_c=anova_c)
}

# --- Correr ---
fases <- c("Phase1", "Phase2", "Phase3", "Phase4")

results_surf <- lapply(fases, function(ph)
  run_varpart_phase(ph, datos_surface_filtrados, ordenes_surface_rel))
names(results_surf) <- fases

results_bot <- lapply(fases, function(ph)
  run_varpart_phase(ph, datos_bottom_filtrados, ordenes_bottom_rel))
names(results_bot) <- fases
```



```{r}
# ============================================================
#  FIGURA EULER - 4 FASES × 2 PROFUNDIDADES
# ============================================================

sig <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p))    return("")
  if (p <= 0.001)  return("***")
  if (p <= 0.01)   return("**")
  if (p <= 0.05)   return("*")
  return("ns")
}

col_amb <- "#2166AC"
col_com <- "#D6604D"

phase_labels <- c(
  "Phase1" = "Phase I (Days 1-11)",
  "Phase2" = "Phase II (Days 12-19)",
  "Phase3" = "Phase III (Days 20-37)",
  "Phase4" = "Phase IV (Days 38-50)"
)

plot_euler_phase <- function(res, depth_label) {
  if (is.null(res)) {
    grid.text("Insufficient data", gp = gpar(col = "grey50", cex = 0.9))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Valores positivos para euler (no acepta negativos)
  a_plot <- max(res$a, 0)
  b_plot <- max(res$b, 0)
  c_plot <- max(res$c, 0)
  
  fit <- tryCatch(
    euler(c(
      "Environment"           = a_plot,
      "Community"             = c_plot,
      "Environment&Community" = b_plot
    )),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    grid.text("Could not fit Euler", gp = gpar(col = "grey50", cex = 0.8))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  f_a <- if (!is.null(res$anova_a)) round(res$anova_a[1, "F"], 2) else NA
  f_c <- if (!is.null(res$anova_c)) round(res$anova_c[1, "F"], 2) else NA
  
  label_a <- paste0(round(a_plot*100, 1), "%",
                    if (!is.na(f_a)) paste0("\nF=", f_a, " ", sig(res$p_a)) else "")
  label_c <- paste0(round(c_plot*100, 1), "%",
                    if (!is.na(f_c)) paste0("\nF=", f_c, " ", sig(res$p_c)) else "")
  label_b <- paste0(round(b_plot*100, 1), "%")
  
  print(plot(fit,
       fills     = list(fill = c(col_amb, col_com), alpha = 0.45),
       edges     = list(col  = c(col_amb, col_com), lwd = 2),
       labels    = list(labels = c("Environment", "Community"), font = 2, cex = 0.85),
       quantities = list(labels = c(label_a, label_c, label_b), font = 1, cex = 0.78),
       main = paste0(depth_label, "\n", phase_labels[res$phase])),
  newpage = FALSE)
  
  grid.text(
    paste0("[d] Residual = ", round(res$d*100, 1), "%"),
    x = 0.5, y = 0.04,
    gp = gpar(col = "grey40", cex = 0.70)
  )
}

# --- Dibujar figura: 2 columnas (Surface | Subsurface) × 4 filas (fases) ---
grid.newpage()
pushViewport(viewport(layout = grid.layout(nrow = 4, ncol = 2)))

for (i in 1:4) {
  ph <- fases[i]
  
  # Superficie
  pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = i, layout.pos.col = 1))
  plot_euler_phase(results_surf[[ph]], "Surface")
  popViewport()
  
  # Subsuperficie
  pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = i, layout.pos.col = 2))
  plot_euler_phase(results_bot[[ph]], "Subsurface")
  popViewport()
}
```

# bajando el umbral por baja cantidad de datos

```{r}
# ============================================================
#  VARIANCE PARTITIONING POR FASES - VERSIÓN FINAL
#  Adaptada para muestras pequeñas (n >= 4)
# ============================================================

library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(eulerr)
library(grid)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# FUNCIÓN PRINCIPAL
# ------------------------------------------------------------
run_varpart_phase <- function(phase_name, lip_data, bac_data) {
  
  cat("\n", rep("=", 50), "\n")
  cat("  FASE:", phase_name, "\n")
  cat(rep("=", 50), "\n")
  
  # --- 1. Filtrar por fase ---
  idx_lip <- lip_data$typeset == phase_name
  idx_bac <- bac_data$typeset == phase_name
  lip_ph  <- lip_data[idx_lip, ]
  bac_ph  <- bac_data[idx_bac, ]
  
  cat("Muestras lípidos:", sum(idx_lip),
      "| Muestras bacterias:", sum(idx_bac), "\n")
  
  # --- 2. Match por ID ---
  ids_comunes <- intersect(lip_ph$ID, bac_ph$ID)
  
  if (length(ids_comunes) < 4) {
    cat("⚠ Menos de 4 muestras comunes, saltando fase", phase_name, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  cat("Muestras comunes:", length(ids_comunes), "\n")
  
  lip_ph <- lip_ph[match(ids_comunes, lip_ph$ID), ]
  bac_ph <- bac_ph[match(ids_comunes, bac_ph$ID), ]
  
  # --- 3. Matrices ---
  env_m <- lip_ph[, 3:12]
  lip_m <- lip_ph[, 13:ncol(lip_ph)]
  bac_m <- bac_ph[, sapply(bac_ph, is.numeric)]
  
  rows_ok <- complete.cases(env_m)
  env_m   <- env_m[rows_ok, ]
  lip_m   <- lip_m[rows_ok, ]
  bac_m   <- bac_m[rows_ok, ]
  n <- nrow(env_m)
  
  cat("Muestras tras eliminar NAs:", n, "\n")
  
  if (n < 4) {
    cat("⚠ Muy pocas muestras completas, saltando\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # --- 4. Hellinger ---
  lip_hell <- decostand(lip_m, method = "hellinger")
  
  # --- 5. Reducir ambiente a ejes PCA ---
  # n <= 6  → k=1 eje
  # n >= 7  → k=2 ejes
  # nunca más de n-2 predictores totales
  k_env <- ifelse(n <= 6, 1, 2)
  k_bac <- ifelse(n <= 6, 1, 2)
  
  # Verificar que k_env + k_bac < n (regla de oro para RDA)
  while ((k_env + k_bac) >= (n - 1) && k_env > 0) {
    k_env <- k_env - 1
  }
  
  cat("k ambiente:", k_env, "| k bacterias:", k_bac,
      "| Total predictores:", k_env + k_bac, "| n:", n, "\n")
  
  # PCA ambiente
  env_scaled <- scale(env_m)
  # Eliminar columnas con NA o varianza 0 tras escalar
  cols_ok    <- apply(env_scaled, 2, function(x) !any(is.na(x)) && var(x) > 0)
  env_scaled <- env_scaled[, cols_ok]
  
  pca_env <- prcomp(env_scaled, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
  env_pca <- as.data.frame(pca_env$x[, 1:k_env, drop = FALSE])
  colnames(env_pca) <- paste0("EnvPC", 1:k_env)
  
  var_env <- round(summary(pca_env)$importance[2, 1:k_env] * 100, 1)
  cat("Varianza PCA ambiente:", paste(var_env, collapse = " + "), "%\n")
  
  # PCoA bacterias
  pcoa_res <- cmdscale(vegdist(bac_m, method = "bray"), k = k_bac, eig = TRUE)
  bac_pcoa <- as.data.frame(pcoa_res$points[, 1:k_bac, drop = FALSE])
  colnames(bac_pcoa) <- paste0("PCoA", 1:k_bac)
  
  var_bac <- round(pcoa_res$eig / sum(pcoa_res$eig[pcoa_res$eig > 0]) * 100, 1)
  cat("Varianza PCoA bacterias:", sum(var_bac[1:k_bac]), "%\n")
  
  # --- 6. Variance partitioning ---
  vp <- tryCatch(
    varpart(lip_hell, env_pca, bac_pcoa),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("⚠ varpart falló:", e$message, "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  if (is.null(vp)) return(NULL)
  
  # --- 7. Tests de significancia ---
  anova_a <- tryCatch(
    anova(rda(lip_hell, env_pca, bac_pcoa), permutations = 999),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  anova_c <- tryCatch(
    anova(rda(lip_hell, bac_pcoa, env_pca), permutations = 999),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  # --- 8. Extraer fracciones ---
  a_val <- vp$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[1]
  b_val <- vp$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[2]
  c_val <- vp$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[3]
  d_val <- vp$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[4]
  p_a   <- if (!is.null(anova_a)) anova_a$`Pr(>F)`[1] else NA
  p_c   <- if (!is.null(anova_c)) anova_c$`Pr(>F)`[1] else NA
  
  cat(sprintf("[a] Ambiente único:  %.1f%%  (p=%.3f)\n", a_val*100, ifelse(is.na(p_a), NaN, p_a)))
  cat(sprintf("[b] Compartido:      %.1f%%\n",            b_val*100))
  cat(sprintf("[c] Comunidad única: %.1f%%  (p=%.3f)\n", c_val*100, ifelse(is.na(p_c), NaN, p_c)))
  cat(sprintf("[d] Residual:        %.1f%%\n",            d_val*100))
  
  list(
    phase   = phase_name,
    n       = n,
    k_env   = k_env,
    k_bac   = k_bac,
    a = a_val, b = b_val, c = c_val, d = d_val,
    p_a = p_a, p_c = p_c,
    vp  = vp,
    anova_a = anova_a,
    anova_c = anova_c
  )
}

sig <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p))   return("")
  if (p <= 0.001) return("***")
  if (p <= 0.01)  return("**")
  if (p <= 0.05)  return("*")
  return("ns")
}

col_amb <- "#2166AC"
col_com <- "#D6604D"

phase_labels <- c(
  "Phase1" = "Phase I (Days 1-11)",
  "Phase2" = "Phase II (Days 12-19)",
  "Phase3" = "Phase III (Days 20-37)",
  "Phase4" = "Phase IV (Days 38-50)"
)

plot_euler_phase <- function(res, depth_label) {
  
  if (is.null(res)) {
    grid.rect(gp = gpar(fill = "grey95", col = "grey80"))
    grid.text("Insufficient data\n(n < 4)",
              gp = gpar(col = "grey50", cex = 0.85))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  a_plot <- max(res$a, 0)
  b_plot <- max(res$b, 0)
  c_plot <- max(res$c, 0)
  
  if ((a_plot + b_plot + c_plot) == 0) {
    grid.rect(gp = gpar(fill = "grey95", col = "grey80"))
    grid.text("All fractions ≤ 0",
              gp = gpar(col = "grey50", cex = 0.85))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  fit <- tryCatch(
    euler(c(
      "Environment"           = a_plot,
      "Community"             = c_plot,
      "Environment&Community" = b_plot
    )),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    grid.rect(gp = gpar(fill = "grey95", col = "grey80"))
    grid.text("Could not fit Euler",
              gp = gpar(col = "grey50", cex = 0.8))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  f_a <- if (!is.null(res$anova_a)) round(res$anova_a[1, "F"], 2) else NA
  f_c <- if (!is.null(res$anova_c)) round(res$anova_c[1, "F"], 2) else NA
  
  label_a <- paste0(round(a_plot*100, 1), "%",
                    if (!is.na(f_a)) paste0("\nF=", f_a, " ", sig(res$p_a)) else "")
  label_c <- paste0(round(c_plot*100, 1), "%",
                    if (!is.na(f_c)) paste0("\nF=", f_c, " ", sig(res$p_c)) else "")
  label_b <- paste0(round(b_plot*100, 1), "%")
  
  # Título corto para evitar solapamiento
  main_title <- paste0(phase_labels[res$phase], " (n=", res$n, ")")
  
  print(
    plot(fit,
         fills      = list(fill = c(col_amb, col_com), alpha = 0.45),
         edges      = list(col  = c(col_amb, col_com), lwd = 2),
         labels     = list(labels = c("Environment", "Community"),
                           font = 2, cex = 0.80),
         quantities = list(labels = c(label_a, label_c, label_b),
                           font = 1, cex = 0.75),
         main = list(label = main_title, cex = 0.85)),
    newpage = FALSE
  )
  
  grid.text(
    paste0("[d] Residual = ", round(res$d*100, 1), "%  |  ",
           "Total explained = ", round((1 - max(res$d, 0))*100, 1), "%"),
    x  = 0.5, y = 0.03,
    gp = gpar(col = "grey40", cex = 0.65)
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
#  VARIANCE PARTITIONING POR FASES - VERSIÓN FLEXIBLE
#  k adaptativo según n disponible
# ============================================================

library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(eulerr)
library(grid)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# FUNCIÓN PRINCIPAL
# ------------------------------------------------------------
run_varpart_phase <- function(phase_name, lip_data, bac_data) {
  
  cat("\n", rep("=", 50), "\n")
  cat("  FASE:", phase_name, "\n")
  cat(rep("=", 50), "\n")
  
  # --- 1. Filtrar por fase ---
  idx_lip <- lip_data$typeset == phase_name
  idx_bac <- bac_data$typeset == phase_name
  lip_ph  <- lip_data[idx_lip, ]
  bac_ph  <- bac_data[idx_bac, ]
  
  cat("Muestras lípidos:", sum(idx_lip),
      "| Muestras bacterias:", sum(idx_bac), "\n")
  
  # --- 2. Match por ID ---
  ids_comunes <- intersect(lip_ph$ID, bac_ph$ID)
  
  if (length(ids_comunes) < 4) {
    cat("⚠ Menos de 4 muestras comunes, saltando fase", phase_name, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  cat("Muestras comunes:", length(ids_comunes), "\n")
  
  lip_ph <- lip_ph[match(ids_comunes, lip_ph$ID), ]
  bac_ph <- bac_ph[match(ids_comunes, bac_ph$ID), ]
  
  # --- 3. Matrices ---
  env_m <- lip_ph[, 3:12]
  lip_m <- lip_ph[, 13:ncol(lip_ph)]
  bac_m <- bac_ph[, sapply(bac_ph, is.numeric)]
  
  rows_ok <- complete.cases(env_m)
  env_m   <- env_m[rows_ok, ]
  lip_m   <- lip_m[rows_ok, ]
  bac_m   <- bac_m[rows_ok, ]
  n <- nrow(env_m)
  
  cat("Muestras tras eliminar NAs:", n, "\n")
  
  if (n < 4) {
    cat("⚠ Muy pocas muestras completas, saltando\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # --- 4. Hellinger ---
  lip_hell <- decostand(lip_m, method = "hellinger")
  
  # --- 5. k ADAPTATIVO ---
  # Regla: nunca más de floor((n-2)/2) ejes por bloque
  # n=4   → k=1
  # n=5-6 → k=1
  # n=7-8 → k=2
  # n>=9  → k=2 (máximo razonable para estos datos)
  k_max <- max(1, floor((n - 2) / 2))
  k_env <- min(2, k_max)
  k_bac <- min(2, k_max)
  
  cat("n=", n, "→ k_env=", k_env, "| k_bac=", k_bac,
      "| Total predictores:", k_env + k_bac, "\n")
  
  # --- 6. PCA ambiente ---
  env_scaled <- scale(env_m)
  cols_ok    <- apply(env_scaled, 2, function(x) !any(is.na(x)) && var(x) > 0)
  env_scaled <- env_scaled[, cols_ok]
  
  pca_env <- prcomp(env_scaled, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
  env_pca <- as.data.frame(pca_env$x[, 1:k_env, drop = FALSE])
  colnames(env_pca) <- paste0("EnvPC", 1:k_env)
  
  var_env <- round(summary(pca_env)$importance[2, 1:k_env] * 100, 1)
  cat("Varianza PCA ambiente:", paste(var_env, collapse = " + "), "%\n")
  
  # --- 7. PCoA bacterias ---
  pcoa_res <- cmdscale(vegdist(bac_m, method = "bray"), k = k_bac, eig = TRUE)
  bac_pcoa <- as.data.frame(pcoa_res$points[, 1:k_bac, drop = FALSE])
  colnames(bac_pcoa) <- paste0("PCoA", 1:k_bac)
  
  var_bac <- round(pcoa_res$eig / sum(pcoa_res$eig[pcoa_res$eig > 0]) * 100, 1)
  cat("Varianza PCoA bacterias:", sum(var_bac[1:k_bac]), "%\n")
  
  # --- 8. Variance partitioning ---
  vp <- tryCatch(
    varpart(lip_hell, env_pca, bac_pcoa),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("⚠ varpart falló:", e$message, "\n")
      NULL
    }
  )
  if (is.null(vp)) return(NULL)
  
  # --- 9. Tests de significancia ---
  anova_a <- tryCatch(
    anova(rda(lip_hell, env_pca, bac_pcoa), permutations = 999),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  anova_c <- tryCatch(
    anova(rda(lip_hell, bac_pcoa, env_pca), permutations = 999),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  # --- 10. Extraer fracciones ---
  a_val <- vp$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[1]
  b_val <- vp$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[2]
  c_val <- vp$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[3]
  d_val <- vp$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[4]
  p_a   <- if (!is.null(anova_a)) anova_a$`Pr(>F)`[1] else NA
  p_c   <- if (!is.null(anova_c)) anova_c$`Pr(>F)`[1] else NA
  
  cat(sprintf("[a] Ambiente único:  %.1f%%  (p=%.3f)\n", a_val*100, ifelse(is.na(p_a), NaN, p_a)))
  cat(sprintf("[b] Compartido:      %.1f%%\n",            b_val*100))
  cat(sprintf("[c] Comunidad única: %.1f%%  (p=%.3f)\n", c_val*100, ifelse(is.na(p_c), NaN, p_c)))
  cat(sprintf("[d] Residual:        %.1f%%\n",            d_val*100))
  
  list(
    phase   = phase_name,
    n       = n,
    k_env   = k_env,
    k_bac   = k_bac,
    a = a_val, b = b_val, c = c_val, d = d_val,
    p_a = p_a, p_c = p_c,
    vp  = vp,
    anova_a = anova_a,
    anova_c = anova_c
  )
}

# ============================================================
#  CORRER PARA SUPERFICIE Y SUBSUPERFICIE
# ============================================================
```

```{r}
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

  datos_bottom_bac[, ord_sel_b]
)

cat("Órdenes superficie:", length(ord_sel_s), "| Fondo:", length(ord_sel_b), "\n")

# ============================================================
#  PASO 2: FUNCIÓN VARPART
# ============================================================

run_varpart <- function(lip_data, bac_data, label = "") {

  ids <- intersect(lip_data$ID, bac_data$ID)
  if (length(ids) < 4) {
    cat("⚠", label, "- menos de 4 muestras comunes\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  lip_m <- lip_data[match(ids, lip_data$ID), ]
  bac_m <- bac_data[match(ids, bac_data$ID), ]

  env_m <- lip_m[, 3:12]
  lip_m <- lip_m[, 13:ncol(lip_m)]
  bac_m <- bac_m[, sapply(bac_m, is.numeric)]

  rows_ok <- complete.cases(env_m)
  env_m   <- env_m[rows_ok, ]
  lip_m   <- lip_m[rows_ok, ]
  bac_m   <- bac_m[rows_ok, ]
  n       <- nrow(env_m)

  if (n < 4) { cat("⚠", label, "- n <4\n"); return(NULL) }
  cat("\n---", label, "| n =", n, "---\n")

  k_max <- max(1, floor((n - 2) / 2))
  k_env <- min(2, k_max)
  k_bac <- min(3, k_max)
  cat("k_env =", k_env, "| k_bac =", k_bac, "\n")

  lip_hell <- decostand(lip_m, method = "hellinger")

  env_scaled <- scale(env_m)
  cols_ok    <- apply(env_scaled, 2, function(x) !any(is.na(x)) && var(x) > 0)
  env_scaled <- env_scaled[, cols_ok]
  pca_env    <- prcomp(env_scaled, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
  env_pca    <- as.data.frame(pca_env$x[, 1:k_env, drop = FALSE])
  colnames(env_pca) <- paste0("EnvPC", 1:k_env)

  pcoa_res <- cmdscale(vegdist(bac_m, method = "bray"), k = k_bac, eig = TRUE)
  bac_pcoa <- as.data.frame(pcoa_res$points[, 1:k_bac, drop = FALSE])
  colnames(bac_pcoa) <- paste0("PCoA", 1:k_bac)

  vp <- tryCatch(
    varpart(lip_hell, env_pca, bac_pcoa),
    error = function(e) { cat("⚠ varpart falló\n"); NULL }
  )
  if (is.null(vp)) return(NULL)

  anova_a <- tryCatch(
    anova(rda(lip_hell, env_pca, bac_pcoa), permutations = 999),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  anova_c <- tryCatch(
    anova(rda(lip_hell, bac_pcoa, env_pca), permutations = 999),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  a_val <- vp$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[1]
  b_val <- vp$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[2]
  c_val <- vp$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[3]
  d_val <- vp$part$indfract$Adj.R.squared[4]
  p_a   <- if (!is.null(anova_a)) anova_a$`Pr(>F)`[1] else NA
  p_c   <- if (!is.null(anova_c)) anova_c$`Pr(>F)`[1] else NA

  cat(sprintf("[a]=%.1f%%(p=%.3f) [b]=%.1f%% [c]=%.1f%%(p=%.3f) [d]=%.1f%%\n",
      a_val*100, ifelse(is.na(p_a), NaN, p_a),
      b_val*100, c_val*100, ifelse(is.na(p_c), NaN, p_c),
      d_val*100))

  list(label=label, n=n, k_env=k_env, k_bac=k_bac,
       a=a_val, b=b_val, c=c_val, d=d_val,
       p_a=p_a, p_c=p_c,
       vp=vp, anova_a=anova_a, anova_c=anova_c)
}

# ============================================================
#  PASO 3: VARPART GLOBAL
# ============================================================

cat("\n========== GLOBAL ==========\n")
res_glob_surf <- run_varpart(datos_surface_filtrados, ordenes_surface_rel,
                              "Global Surface")
res_glob_bot  <- run_varpart(datos_bottom_filtrados,  ordenes_bottom_rel,
                              "Global Subsurface")

# ============================================================
#  PASO 4: FIGURA EULER GLOBAL
# ============================================================

sig <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p))   return("")
  if (p <= 0.001) return("***")
  if (p <= 0.01)  return("**")
  if (p <= 0.05)  return("*")
  return("ns")
}

col_amb <- "#2166AC"
col_com <- "#D6604D"

make_euler_grob <- function(res, title) {
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  a <- res$a; b <- res$b; c <- res$c; d <- res$d
  f_a <- if (!is.null(res$anova_a)) round(res$anova_a[1, "F"], 2) else NA
  p_a <- res$p_a
  f_c <- if (!is.null(res$anova_c)) round(res$anova_c[1, "F"], 2) else NA
  p_c <- res$p_c

  fit <- euler(c(
    "Environment"           = max(a, 0),
    "Community"             = max(c, 0),
    "Environment&Community" = max(b, 0)
  ))

  as.grob(function() {
    print(plot(fit,
         fills      = list(fill = c(col_amb, col_com), alpha = 0.45),
         edges      = list(col  = c(col_amb, col_com), lwd = 2),
         labels     = list(labels = c("Environment", "Community"),
                           font = 2, cex = 1.1),
         quantities = list(
           labels = c(
             paste0(round(max(a,0)*100,1), "%\nF=", f_a, " ", sig(p_a)),
             paste0(round(max(c,0)*100,1), "%\nF=", f_c, " ", sig(p_c)),
             paste0(round(max(b,0)*100,1), "%")
           ), font = 1, cex = 0.95),
         main = list(label = paste0(title, " (n=", res$n, ")"),
                     cex = 1.2, fontface = "bold")))
    grid.text(
      paste0("[d] Residual = ", round(d*100,1),
             "%  |  Total explained = ", round((1-max(d,0))*100,1), "%"),
      x = 0.5, y = 0.04,
      gp = gpar(col = "grey40", cex = 0.75)
    )
  })
}

grob_surf <- make_euler_grob(res_glob_surf, "Surface")
grob_bot  <- make_euler_grob(res_glob_bot,  "Subsurface")
```

```{r}
phase_titles <- c(
  "Phase1" = "Phase I\n(Days 1-11)",
  "Phase2" = "Phase II\n(Days 12-19)",
  "Phase3" = "Phase III\n(Days 20-37)",
  "Phase4" = "Phase IV\n(Days 38-50)"
)

make_euler_phase_grob <- function(res, phase_name) {

  # Si no hay resultado suficiente, mostrar caja gris
  if (is.null(res)) {
    return(as.grob(function() {
      grid.rect(gp = gpar(fill = "grey95", col = "grey80"))
      grid.text(paste0(phase_titles[phase_name], "\nInsufficient data\n(n < 4)"),
                gp = gpar(col = "grey50", cex = 0.85))
    }))
  }

  a <- res$a; b <- res$b; c <- res$c; d <- res$d
  f_a <- if (!is.null(res$anova_a)) round(res$anova_a[1, "F"], 2) else NA
  p_a <- res$p_a
  f_c <- if (!is.null(res$anova_c)) round(res$anova_c[1, "F"], 2) else NA
  p_c <- res$p_c

  # Si todas las fracciones son <= 0
  if (max(c(max(a,0), max(b,0), max(c,0))) == 0) {
    return(as.grob(function() {
      grid.rect(gp = gpar(fill = "grey95", col = "grey80"))
      grid.text(paste0(phase_titles[phase_name], "\nAll fractions ≤ 0"),
                gp = gpar(col = "grey50", cex = 0.85))
    }))
  }

  fit <- tryCatch(
    euler(c(
      "Environment"           = max(a, 0),
      "Community"             = max(c, 0),
      "Environment&Community" = max(b, 0)
    )),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(as.grob(function() {
      grid.rect(gp = gpar(fill = "grey95", col = "grey80"))
      grid.text(paste0(phase_titles[phase_name], "\nCould not fit"),
                gp = gpar(col = "grey50", cex = 0.85))
    }))
  }

  as.grob(function() {
    print(plot(fit,
         fills      = list(fill = c(col_amb, col_com), alpha = 0.45),
         edges      = list(col  = c(col_amb, col_com), lwd = 2),
         labels     = list(labels = c("Environment", "Community"),
                           font = 2, cex = 0.85),
         quantities = list(
           labels = c(
             paste0(round(max(a,0)*100,1), "%",
                    if (!is.na(f_a)) paste0("\nF=", f_a, " ", sig(p_a)) else ""),
             paste0(round(max(c,0)*100,1), "%",
                    if (!is.na(f_c)) paste0("\nF=", f_c, " ", sig(p_c)) else ""),
             paste0(round(max(b,0)*100,1), "%")
           ), font = 1, cex = 0.78),
         main = list(label = paste0(phase_titles[phase_name],
                                    " (n=", res$n, ")"),
                     cex = 0.90, fontface = "bold")))
    grid.text(
      paste0("[d] Residual = ", round(d*100,1), "%"),
      x = 0.5, y = 0.03,
      gp = gpar(col = "grey40", cex = 0.65)
    )
  })
}
```

#OVERLAAP DE DIAAS
```{r}
# ============================================================
#  VARPART CON VENTANAS TEMPORALES SOLAPADAS
#  VERSION COMPLETA
# ============================================================

library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(eulerr)
library(grid)
library(cowplot)
library(ggplotify)

# ============================================================
#  EXTRAER DAY DESDE ID
# ============================================================

datos_surface_filtrados$Day <- as.numeric(
  sub(".*_Day_([0-9]+).*",
      "\\1",
      datos_surface_filtrados$ID)
)

ordenes_surface_rel$Day <- as.numeric(
  sub(".*_Day_([0-9]+).*",
      "\\1",
      ordenes_surface_rel$ID)
)

# ============================================================
#  REVISAR
# ============================================================

table(datos_surface_filtrados$Day)

# ============================================================
#  COLORES
# ============================================================

col_amb <- "#2166AC"
col_com <- "#D6604D"

# ============================================================
#  FUNCION SIGNIFICANCIA
# ============================================================

sig <- function(p) {

  if (is.na(p))   return("")
  if (p <= 0.001) return("***")
  if (p <= 0.01)  return("**")
  if (p <= 0.05)  return("*")

  return("ns")
}

# ============================================================
#  FUNCION VARPART MINIMAL
# ============================================================

run_varpart_minimal <- function(lip_data,
                                bac_data,
                                label = "") {

  cat("\n============================\n")
  cat(label, "\n")
  cat("============================\n")

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # MATCH IDS
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  ids <- intersect(
    lip_data$ID,
    bac_data$ID
  )

  if (length(ids) < 4) {

    cat("⚠ Menos de 4 muestras\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  lip_m <- lip_data[
    match(ids, lip_data$ID),
  ]

  bac_m <- bac_data[
    match(ids, bac_data$ID),
  ]

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # MATRICES
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  env_m <- lip_m[, 3:12]

  lip_m <- lip_m[, 13:(ncol(lip_m)-1)]

  bac_m <- bac_m[, sapply(bac_m, is.numeric)]

  # remover Day del bacteriano
  bac_m <- bac_m[, !colnames(bac_m) %in% "Day"]

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # COMPLETE CASES
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  rows_ok <- complete.cases(env_m)

  env_m <- env_m[
    rows_ok,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  lip_m <- lip_m[
    rows_ok,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  bac_m <- bac_m[
    rows_ok,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  n <- nrow(env_m)

  cat("n =", n, "\n")

  if (n < 4) {

    cat("⚠ n insuficiente\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # ELIMINAR VARIABLES CONSTANTES
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  env_var <- apply(
    env_m,
    2,
    var,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  lip_var <- apply(
    lip_m,
    2,
    var,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  bac_var <- apply(
    bac_m,
    2,
    var,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  env_m <- env_m[
    ,
    env_var > 0,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  lip_m <- lip_m[
    ,
    lip_var > 0,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  bac_m <- bac_m[
    ,
    bac_var > 0,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  cat("Variables ambientales:", ncol(env_m), "\n")
  cat("Lípidos:", ncol(lip_m), "\n")
  cat("Órdenes:", ncol(bac_m), "\n")

  if (ncol(env_m) < 1 |
      ncol(lip_m) < 2 |
      ncol(bac_m) < 2) {

    cat("⚠ Muy poca variación\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # HELLINGER
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  lip_hell <- decostand(
    lip_m,
    method = "hellinger"
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # PCA AMBIENTAL
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  env_scaled <- scale(env_m)

  pca_env <- tryCatch(

    prcomp(
      env_scaled,
      center = FALSE,
      scale. = FALSE
    ),

    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(pca_env)) {

    cat("⚠ PCA ambiental falló\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  env_pca <- data.frame(
    EnvPC1 = pca_env$x[,1]
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # PCoA BACTERIANO
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  dist_bac <- tryCatch(

    vegdist(
      bac_m,
      method = "bray"
    ),

    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(dist_bac)) {

    cat("⚠ Bray falló\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  pcoa_res <- tryCatch(

    cmdscale(
      dist_bac,
      k = 1,
      eig = TRUE
    ),

    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(pcoa_res)) {

    cat("⚠ PCoA falló\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  bac_pcoa <- data.frame(
    PCoA1 = pcoa_res$points[,1]
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # VARPART
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  vp <- tryCatch(

    varpart(
      lip_hell,
      env_pca,
      bac_pcoa
    ),

    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(vp)) {

    cat("⚠ varpart falló\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # EXTRAER FRACCIONES
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  fract <- vp$part$indfract

  a_val <- fract["[a]", "Adj.R.squared"]
  b_val <- fract["[b]", "Adj.R.squared"]
  c_val <- fract["[c]", "Adj.R.squared"]
  d_val <- fract["[d]", "Adj.R.squared"]

  # negativos -> 0
  a_plot <- max(a_val, 0)
  b_plot <- max(b_val, 0)
  c_plot <- max(c_val, 0)
  d_plot <- max(d_val, 0)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # ANOVA
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  anova_a <- tryCatch(

    anova(
      rda(
        lip_hell,
        env_pca,
        bac_pcoa
      ),
      permutations = 999
    ),

    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  anova_c <- tryCatch(

    anova(
      rda(
        lip_hell,
        bac_pcoa,
        env_pca
      ),
      permutations = 999
    ),

    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  p_a <- if (!is.null(anova_a)) {
    anova_a$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  } else {
    NA
  }

  p_c <- if (!is.null(anova_c)) {
    anova_c$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  } else {
    NA
  }

  cat(sprintf(
    "[a]=%.1f%% | [b]=%.1f%% | [c]=%.1f%% | [d]=%.1f%%\n",
    a_plot * 100,
    b_plot * 100,
    c_plot * 100,
    d_plot * 100
  ))

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # RETURN
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  list(
    label = label,
    n = n,

    a = a_plot,
    b = b_plot,
    c = c_plot,
    d = d_plot,

    p_a = p_a,
    p_c = p_c,

    anova_a = anova_a,
    anova_c = anova_c
  )
}

# ============================================================
#  VENTANAS TEMPORALES SOLAPADAS
# ============================================================

windows <- list(

  "W1" = c(1, 11),
  "W2" = c(12, 20),
  "W3" = c(18, 24),
  "W4" = c(20, 50)
)

# ============================================================
#  TITULOS
# ============================================================

window_titles <- c(

  "W1" = "Window 1\n(Days 1-11)",
  "W2" = "Window 2\n(Days 12-20)",
  "W3" = "Window 3\n(Days 18-24)",
  "W4" = "Window 4\n(Days 20-50)"
)
# ============================================================
#  CORRER ANALISIS
# ============================================================

results_windows <- lapply(
  names(windows),
  function(w) {

    d1 <- windows[[w]][1]
    d2 <- windows[[w]][2]

    lip_w <- datos_surface_filtrados %>%
      filter(
        Day >= d1 &
        Day <= d2
      )

    bac_w <- ordenes_surface_rel %>%
      filter(
        Day >= d1 &
        Day <= d2
      )

    run_varpart_minimal(
      lip_w,
      bac_w,
      paste0(
        w,
        " (Days ",
        d1,
        "-",
        d2,
        ")"
      )
    )
  }
)

names(results_windows) <- names(windows)

# ============================================================
#  FUNCION EULER
# ============================================================

make_euler_window_grob <- function(res,
                                   window_name) {

  if (is.null(res)) {

    return(as.grob(function() {

      grid.rect(
        gp = gpar(
          fill = "grey95",
          col = "grey80"
        )
      )

      grid.text(
        paste0(
          window_titles[window_name],
          "\nNo structure"
        ),
        gp = gpar(
          col = "grey40",
          cex = 0.85
        )
      )
    }))
  }

  a <- res$a
  b <- res$b
  c <- res$c
  d <- res$d

  if ((a + b + c) <= 0) {

    return(as.grob(function() {

      grid.rect(
        gp = gpar(
          fill = "grey95",
          col = "grey80"
        )
      )

      grid.text(
        paste0(
          window_titles[window_name],
          "\nAll fractions ≤ 0"
        ),
        gp = gpar(
          col = "grey40",
          cex = 0.85
        )
      )
    }))
  }

  fit <- tryCatch(

    euler(
      c(
        "Environment" = max(a, 0.001),
        "Community" = max(c, 0.001),
        "Environment&Community" = max(b, 0.001)
      ),
      shape = "ellipse"
    ),

    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) {

    return(as.grob(function() {

      grid.rect(
        gp = gpar(
          fill = "grey95",
          col = "grey80"
        )
      )

      grid.text(
        paste0(
          window_titles[window_name],
          "\nEuler failed"
        ),
        gp = gpar(
          col = "grey40",
          cex = 0.85
        )
      )
    }))
  }

  f_a <- if (!is.null(res$anova_a)) {
    round(res$anova_a[1, "F"], 2)
  } else {
    NA
  }

  f_c <- if (!is.null(res$anova_c)) {
    round(res$anova_c[1, "F"], 2)
  } else {
    NA
  }

  as.grob(function() {

    print(

      plot(
        fit,

        fills = list(
          fill = c(col_amb, col_com),
          alpha = 0.35
        ),

        edges = list(
          col = c(col_amb, col_com),
          lwd = 2.5
        ),

        labels = list(
          labels = c(
            "Environment",
            "Community"
          ),
          font = 2,
          cex = 0.8
        ),

        quantities = list(

          labels = c(

            paste0(
              round(a * 100, 1),
              "%",
              "\nF=",
              f_a,
              " ",
              sig(res$p_a)
            ),

            paste0(
              round(c * 100, 1),
              "%",
              "\nF=",
              f_c,
              " ",
              sig(res$p_c)
            ),

            paste0(
              round(b * 100, 1),
              "%"
            )
          ),

          font = 1,
          cex = 0.72
        ),

        main = list(
          label = paste0(
            window_titles[window_name],
            "\n(n=",
            res$n,
            ")"
          ),
          cex = 0.9,
          fontface = "bold"
        )
      )
    )

    grid.text(
      paste0(
        "Residual = ",
        round(d * 100, 1),
        "%"
      ),
      x = 0.5,
      y = 0.03,
      gp = gpar(
        col = "grey40",
        cex = 0.65
      )
    )
  })
}

# ============================================================
#  CREAR GROB
# ============================================================
```

```{r}
# Extraer matriz de p-valores
pval_matrix <- posthoc_result$p.value

# Inicializar vectores vacíos
comparisons <- c()
pvals <- c()

# Recorrer la matriz triangular superior
for (i in seq_len(nrow(pval_matrix))) {
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(pval_matrix))) {
    if (!is.na(pval_matrix[i, j])) {
      comp <- paste(rownames(pval_matrix)[i], "vs", colnames(pval_matrix)[j])
      comparisons <- c(comparisons, comp)
      pvals <- c(pvals, pval_matrix[i, j])
    }
  }
}

# Crear dataframe
posthoc_df <- data.frame(
  Comparison = comparisons,
  p.value = pvals
)

# Añadir columna de significancia
posthoc_df$Significance <- cut(posthoc_df$p.value,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, Inf),
  labels = c("***", "**", "*", ".", "ns")
)

# Mostrar tabla
print(posthoc_df)
```

```{r}
plot_rda_scaled <- function(df, title_label) {
  library(vegan)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(scales)

  # Separar variables ambientales y órdenes bacterianas
  env_data <- df[, 3:12]
  com_data <- df[, 13:ncol(df)]

  # Filtrar filas completas
  rows_complete <- complete.cases(env_data)
  env_data_clean <- env_data[rows_complete, ]
  com_data_clean <- com_data[rows_complete, ]
  df_clean <- df[rows_complete, ]

  # RDA
  rda_model <- rda(com_data_clean ~ ., data = env_data_clean)

  # Coordenadas de sitios
  sites_df <- scores(rda_model, display = "sites", scaling = 2) %>% as.data.frame()
  sites_df$ID <- df_clean$ID
  sites_df$group <- df_clean$typeset
  sites_df$Label <- gsub(".*Mesocosm ([0-9]+_Day_[0-9]+)", "M\\1", sites_df$ID)

  # Orden de fases
  sites_df$group <- factor(sites_df$group, levels = c("Phase1", "Phase2", "Phase3", "Phase4"))
  colnames(sites_df)[1:2] <- c("RDA1", "RDA2")

  # Variables ambientales
  env_vectors <- scores(rda_model, display = "bp", scaling = 2)
  env_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = rownames(env_vectors),
    RDA1 = env_vectors[, 1],
    RDA2 = env_vectors[, 2]
  )

  # Escalar a [0, 1]
  sites_df$RDA1 <- rescale(sites_df$RDA1)
  sites_df$RDA2 <- rescale(sites_df$RDA2)
  env_df$RDA1 <- rescale(env_df$RDA1)
  env_df$RDA2 <- rescale(env_df$RDA2)

  # Convex hulls
  convex_hull_df <- sites_df %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    slice(chull(RDA1, RDA2))

  # Plot
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = 2, color = "grey70") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = 2, color = "grey70") +
    geom_polygon(data = convex_hull_df, 
                 aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, group = group, fill = group, color = group), 
                 alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_point(data = sites_df, 
               aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, color = group, shape = group), size = 4) +
    geom_text_repel(data = sites_df, 
                    aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, label = Label), 
                    size = 2.5, max.overlaps = Inf) +
    geom_segment(data = env_df, 
                 aes(x = 0.5, y = 0.5, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2), 
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), color = "steelblue") +
    geom_text_repel(data = env_df, 
                    aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, label = Variable), 
                    size = 4, color = "steelblue") +
    labs(title = title_label, x = "Scaled RDA1", y = "Scaled RDA2") +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Phase",
                       values = c(
                         "Phase1" = "#99002F",
                         "Phase2" = "#FDBF6F",
                         "Phase3" = "#A6CEE3",
                         "Phase4" = "#1F78B4"
                       )) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Phase",
                      values = c(
                        "Phase1" = "#99002F",
                        "Phase2" = "#FDBF6F",
                        "Phase3" = "#A6CEE3",
                        "Phase4" = "#1F78B4"
                      )) +
    scale_shape_manual(name = "Phase",
                       values = c("Phase1" = 21, "Phase2" = 22, "Phase3" = 23, "Phase4" = 24)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)) +
    coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1))

  return(list(plot = p, model = rda_model, data = df_clean))
}
```

#Analisis de PERMANOVA

```{r}
# Cargar paquetes necesarios
library(vegan)
library(RVAideMemoire)
library(dplyr)

# Leer archivo de datos
datos_fusionados <- read.csv("~/Documents/Edgart_Flores/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/IPL_NITROGEN/Diversity/merged_data_clean_M5_M6_ORDER_phases_final.csv")

# ------------------------- #
# FUNCIONES AUXILIARES ---- #
# ------------------------- #

# PERMANOVA global
crear_tabla_permanova <- function(layer, resultado) {
  data.frame(
    Layer = layer,
    Test = "PERMANOVA",
    Comparison = "All phases",
    R2 = round(resultado$R2[1], 3),
    F_value = round(resultado$F[1], 3),
    p_value = round(resultado$`Pr(>F)`[1], 4),
    Significance = ifelse(resultado$`Pr(>F)`[1] < 0.001, "***",
                   ifelse(resultado$`Pr(>F)`[1] < 0.01, "**",
                   ifelse(resultado$`Pr(>F)`[1] < 0.05, "*",
                   ifelse(resultado$`Pr(>F)`[1] < 0.1, ".", "ns"))))
  )
}

# Post-hoc (solo si hay datos válidos)
crear_tabla_posthoc <- function(distancia, grupo, capa) {
  posthoc <- pairwise.perm.manova(distancia, grupo, nperm = 999, p.method = "fdr")
  pval_matrix <- as.matrix(posthoc$p.value)

  if (is.null(rownames(pval_matrix)) || is.null(colnames(pval_matrix))) return(NULL)

  comparisons <- c()
  pvals <- c()

  for (i in 1:(nrow(pval_matrix)-1)) {
    for (j in (i+1):ncol(pval_matrix)) {
      if (!is.na(pval_matrix[i, j])) {
        comp_name <- paste(rownames(pval_matrix)[i], "vs", colnames(pval_matrix)[j])
        comparisons <- c(comparisons, comp_name)
        pvals <- c(pvals, as.numeric(pval_matrix[i, j]))
      }
    }
  }

  if (length(pvals) == 0) return(NULL)

  sig <- cut(pvals,
             breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, Inf),
             labels = c("***", "**", "*", ".", "ns"))

  tabla_posthoc <- data.frame(
    Layer = capa,
    Test = "Pairwise",
    Comparison = comparisons,
    R2 = NA,
    F_value = NA,
    p_value = round(pvals, 4),
    Significance = sig
  )

  return(tabla_posthoc)
}

# ------------------------- #
# ANÁLISIS SURFACE -------- #
# ------------------------- #

datos_surface <- datos_fusionados %>% filter(grepl("Surface", ID))
grupo_surface <- as.factor(datos_surface$typeset)
dist_surface <- dist(datos_surface[, 13:ncol(datos_surface)], method = "euclidean")
permanova_surface <- adonis2(datos_surface[, 13:ncol(datos_surface)] ~ grupo_surface, method = "euclidean", permutations = 999)

tabla_global_surface <- crear_tabla_permanova("Surface", permanova_surface)
tabla_posthoc_surface <- crear_tabla_posthoc(dist_surface, grupo_surface, "Surface")

# ------------------------- #
# ANÁLISIS SUBSURFACE ----- #
# ------------------------- #

datos_bottom <- datos_fusionados %>% filter(grepl("Bottom", ID))
grupo_bottom <- as.factor(datos_bottom$typeset)
dist_bottom <- dist(datos_bottom[, 13:ncol(datos_bottom)], method = "euclidean")
permanova_bottom <- adonis2(datos_bottom[, 13:ncol(datos_bottom)] ~ grupo_bottom, method = "euclidean", permutations = 999)

tabla_global_bottom <- crear_tabla_permanova("Subsurface", permanova_bottom)

# ------------------------- #
# UNIR Y EXPORTAR ---------- #
# ------------------------- #

tabla_final <- bind_rows(
  tabla_global_surface,
  tabla_posthoc_surface,
  tabla_global_bottom
)

write.csv(tabla_final, "tabla_16S_surface_subsurface_final.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


# Ahora vamos a hacer las abundancias relativas por fases y Mescocosms

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(RColorBrewer)

# --- Paso 1: Relativizar ---
ordenes_surface <- datos_surface[, 13:ncol(datos_surface)]
ordenes_surface_rel <- ordenes_surface / rowSums(ordenes_surface, na.rm = TRUE)

# Metadata
ordenes_surface_rel$ID <- datos_surface$ID
ordenes_surface_rel$Mesocosm <- gsub(".*Mesocosm ([0-9]+_Day_[0-9]+)", "M\\1", datos_surface$ID)
ordenes_surface_rel$Phase <- datos_surface$typeset
ordenes_surface_rel$Grupo <- ifelse(grepl("Mesocosm 5", datos_surface$ID), "M5", "M6")

# --- Paso 2: Formato largo + top 27 órdenes ---
ordenes_long <- ordenes_surface_rel %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(ID, Mesocosm, Phase, Grupo),
    names_to = "Orden",
    values_to = "AbundanciaRelativa"
  )

# Top 27 órdenes
ordenes_top <- ordenes_long %>%
  group_by(Orden) %>%
  summarise(Total = sum(AbundanciaRelativa, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  top_n(27, Total) %>%
  pull(Orden)

ordenes_long <- ordenes_long %>%
  mutate(Orden = ifelse(Orden %in% ordenes_top, Orden, "Others"))

# Reordenar factores
ordenes_long$Orden <- fct_reorder(ordenes_long$Orden, ordenes_long$AbundanciaRelativa, .fun = sum, .desc = TRUE)
ordenes_long$Mesocosm <- factor(ordenes_long$Mesocosm)

# --- Paso 3: Paleta extendida RdGy ---
num_colores <- length(unique(ordenes_long$Orden))
palette_rdgy_extended <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "RdGy"))(num_colores)

# --- Paso 4: Gráfico final ---
ggplot(ordenes_long, aes(x = Mesocosm, y = AbundanciaRelativa, fill = Orden)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  facet_wrap(~Grupo, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Order", values = palette_rdgy_extended) +
  labs(
    title = "Relative Abundance of Bacterial Orders – Surface",
    x = "Mesocosm",
    y = "Relative Abundance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  )
```

#Ahora actualicemos la abundancia relativa de los IPLs


```{r}
# Cargar paquetes necesarios
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(stringr)

# ---- 1. Cargar datos y separar Surface / Bottom ----
# Asegurarse de tener los datos cargados
datos <- read.csv("~/Documents/Edgart_Flores/SIC_EFR_PROJECT/IPL_NITROGEN/Diversity/combined_data_only_IPL_envriomental.csv")

datos_surface <- datos %>% filter(grepl("Surface", ID))
datos_bottom  <- datos %>% filter(grepl("Bottom", ID))

# ---- 2. Función para filtrar, clasificar y transformar ----
procesar_datos <- function(df) {
  lipid_cols <- 13:ncol(df)
  df[, lipid_cols] <- mutate(df[, lipid_cols], across(everything(), as.numeric))
  
  suma_lipidos <- colSums(df[, lipid_cols], na.rm = TRUE)
  lipidos_filtrados <- names(suma_lipidos[suma_lipidos > 20])
  
  df_filtrado <- bind_cols(df[, 1:12], df[, lipidos_filtrados])
  
  # Pivot a largo
  df_largo <- df_filtrado %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(lipidos_filtrados), names_to = "Lipido", values_to = "Abundancia") %>%
    
    # Asignar clase
    mutate(
      Clase = case_when(
        str_starts(Lipido, regex("PG|PE|PC|PME|PDME", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Phospholipids",
        str_starts(Lipido, regex("MGDG|DGDG|SQDG", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Glycolipids",
        str_starts(Lipido, regex("DGTA|DGTS|DGCC", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Betaine lipids",
        TRUE ~ "Otros"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(Clase != "Otros")  # Filtrar solo los 3 grupos principales
  
  # Obtener Mesocosm
  df_largo <- df_largo %>%
    mutate(
      Mesocosm = case_when(
        str_detect(ID, "Mesocosm 5") ~ "M5",
        str_detect(ID, "Mesocosm 6") ~ "M6",
        str_detect(ID, "Mesocosm 7") ~ "M7",
        str_detect(ID, "Mesocosm 8") ~ "M8",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      Grupo = case_when(
        Mesocosm %in% c("M5", "M8") ~ "M5_M8",
        Mesocosm %in% c("M6", "M7") ~ "M6_M7",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    drop_na(Mesocosm)
  
  # Calcular abundancia relativa por clase y muestra
  df_rel <- df_largo %>%
    group_by(ID, Clase) %>%
    mutate(AbundanciaRelativa = Abundancia / sum(Abundancia, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  return(df_rel)
}

# ---- 3. Aplicar función ----
surface_rel <- procesar_datos(datos_surface) %>%
  mutate(Profundidad = "Surface")

bottom_rel <- procesar_datos(datos_bottom) %>%
  mutate(Profundidad = "Subsurface")
```

```{r}
# ---- 4. Unir Surface y Bottom, extraer info útil ----
lipidos_relativos <- bind_rows(surface_rel, bottom_rel) %>%
  mutate(
    Day = as.integer(str_extract(ID, "(?<=Day_)[0-9]+")),
    DayLabel = paste0("Day_", Day),
    Clase = factor(Clase, levels = c("Phospholipids", "Glycolipids", "Betaine lipids")),
    Profundidad = factor(Profundidad, levels = c("Surface", "Subsurface")),
    Mesocosm = factor(Mesocosm, levels = c("M5", "M8", "M6", "M7"))
  )
```


```{r}
plot_por_clase <- function(data, clase) {
  data_clase <- data %>% filter(Clase == clase)
  
  # Paleta base por clase
  paleta_base <- case_when(
    clase == "Phospholipids" ~ "RdGy",
    clase == "Glycolipids" ~ "RdBu",
    clase == "Betaine lipids" ~ "Spectral",
    TRUE ~ "Set3"
  )
  
  # Ordenar lípidos por nombre
  lipidos_ordenados <- sort(unique(data_clase$Lipido))
  n <- length(lipidos_ordenados)
  
  # Paleta gradiente para lípidos
  max_colores <- max(brewer.pal.info[paleta_base, "maxcolors"], na.rm = TRUE)
  paleta_gradiente <- setNames(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(max_colores, paleta_base))(n), lipidos_ordenados)
  
  ggplot(data_clase, aes(x = DayLabel, y = AbundanciaRelativa, fill = Lipido)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
    facet_grid(Profundidad ~ Mesocosm, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = paleta_gradiente, name = "Lipid") +
    labs(
      title = clase,
      x = "Day",
      y = "Relative Abundance (%)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, size = 7, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
  strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
  legend.position = "right",
  panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
)
}
```

```{r}
# Mostrar cada clase
print(plot_por_clase(lipidos_relativos, "Phospholipids"))
print(plot_por_clase(lipidos_relativos, "Glycolipids"))
print(plot_por_clase(lipidos_relativos, "Betaine lipids"))
```
